newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tem Fat Hing Fung's RNA seen in HK$170 mln IPO.
newsitem.headline: Tem Fat Hing Fung's RNA seen in HK$170 mln IPO.

text.p: RNA Holdings Ltd, a demerged metals operation of Tem Fat Hing Fung (Holdings) Ltd, is expected to issue 168 million new shares at HK$1.01 each in a Hong Kong flotation, market sources said on Monday.
The new issue will represent 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, they said.
The initial public offering (IPO) is expected to run from November 19-22, with dealing in the company's shares expected to begin on December 2, the sources said.

They said there would be prefered distribution to shareholders of Tem Fat Hing Fung on the basis of one 1998 RNA warrant for every 10 Tem Fat Hing Fung shares held, and one bonus RNA share for every 100 Tem Fat Hing Fung shares.

Bullion, jewellery and property concern Tem Fat Hing Fung had said earlier it would seek a separate listing for RNA, which would engage in refining, casting, assaying, wholesaling and trading of precious metals as well as related arbitrage and hedging operations.

Market sources said Tem Fat Hing Fung's equity interest in RNA would be diluted to 67.5 percent from 90 percent on completion of the deal. The remaining 10 percent of RNA is now owned by Malaysia-based Yayasan Bumiputra Pulau Pinang.

Of the proceeds raised from the new issue, some HK$70 million is expected to be used to cut bank borrowing, HK$15 million to improve the quality management system and HK$30 million to fund development of a jewellery manufacturing centre in Malaysia, with the balance used for working capital, sources said.
RNA forecasts earnings of not less than HK$45 million for the year ending April 30, 1997, up from HK$27 million in 1996, HK$26.61 million in 1995 and HK$44.37 million in 1994, sources added.
CEF Capital Ltd is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, sources said.
